title: responses-vnext: proxy seed & annotations for tool-calls + streaming reassembly fixes
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: Customers are adopting the OpenAI Responses vNext shape which adds a deterministic 'seed' hint and richer top-level metadata annotations. Our openai-compat layer previously dropped these fields for some model adapters and did not forward annotation keys consistently into tool/function-call payloads or the streaming reassembly path. This caused non-deterministic behavior and missing metadata for downstream tooling.

What this PR does: single change set that: (1) forwards the Responses vNext 'seed' hint transparently through the compat proxy when the target model adapter supports determinism hints, falling back to no-op when not supported; (2) proxies top-level metadata annotations into both the final response envelope and into tool/function-call payloads under redwood.metadata to preserve provenance; (3) fixes streaming reassembly edge-cases where interleaved tool-call tokens could arrive out-of-order and cause corrupt function-call invocations during assembly; (4) adds an opt-in feature flag (OPENAI_RESP_VNEXT_PROXY) guarded behind runtime config for gradual rollout; (5) expands integration tests to cover cross-region streaming, seed-forwarding, and metadata-preservation with token-level assertions.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement seed hint passthrough (compat layer + runtime adapters)
- [x] Add metadata annotation proxying for tool-calls and final response
- [x] Fix streaming reassembly ordering bug (race on partial-chunk boundary)
- [x] Add unit and integration tests covering determinism and metadata
- [x] Add documentation note in redwood-docs outlining compatibility behavior and opt-in flag
- [x] Telemetry events for seed-forward decisions and fallback reasons

Related: Linear ENG-9876 (Responses vNext compatibility), ENG-9941 (streaming reassembly), SUP-312 (customer impacted by missing metadata). See design notes: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-9876/responses-vnext-proxy-design (internal).

Notes on behavior: When seed is present in incoming Requests-API shape we attach seed_hint into the internal inference request headers so model-adapters that accept deterministic hints can honor them. If the chosen model does not advertise determinism capability the proxy logs a telemetry event and preserves the original request seed in the final response.metadata.seed for auditability. Metadata keys are merged with a redwood.metadata map before tool-call invocation so downstream tool runners receive context. Streaming reassembly changes introduce a small per-request buffer and an ordering validator that rejects malformed chunk sequences with a 409-style reassembly error that triggers automatic model fallback (same-model cold-retry) to preserve availability.

Observability and rollout: added tracing spans openai_compat.proxy.forward_seed and openai_compat.streaming.reassembly which include request_id and seed_hint when present; added metric openai_compat.seed_forwarded_total with labels (forwarded=true|false, reason=capability|absent). Feature flag OPENAI_RESP_VNEXT_PROXY defaults to off for private/self-hosted installs; enabled for hosted beta customers via org config.

Docs: docs/compat/resp-vnext.md (included) documents explicit fallback semantics and example request/response pairs.
commits_summary: 3 commits: introduce proxy plumbing and feature flag; add streaming reassembly state machine and unit tests; add integration tests and docs update.
review_comments: Liam Chen: Please add a unit test that simulates an adapter that advertises determinism=false so we assert seed lands in response.metadata and telemetry records fallback.
Aisha Patel: Added test simulating deterministic capability negotiation and telemetry assertion (see packages/openai-compat/tests/seed-passthrough.test.ts).
Marisol Vega: The reassembly buffer looks correct but please ensure we bound memory for very large streams; consider a per-request cap and eviction policy.
Aisha Patel: Implemented per-request buffer cap (64KB default) and eviction + metric openai_compat.reassembly.buffer_truncated_total; documented behaviour.
Connor O'Neill: Minor nit: rename openai_compat.streaming.reassembly -> openai_compat.streaming.reassembly_vnext for clarity in tracing.
Aisha Patel: Renamed span and updated docs & tests accordingly.
Marisol Vega: CI initially failed linting in proxy.ts (unused import). After fix, CI passed. Approved for merge.
Liam Chen: Verified integration tests locally (seed + metadata preserved across tool invocation). Approved.
release_notes: Added: Compatibility proxy for OpenAI Responses vNext that forwards deterministic 'seed' hints when supported, preserves seed in response metadata when not supported, proxies top-level annotations into tool/function-call payloads, fixes streaming reassembly ordering bugs, and adds an opt-in feature flag OPENAI_RESP_VNEXT_PROXY.
deployment_instructions: Enable OPENAI_RESP_VNEXT_PROXY via org feature flags for staged rollout. Monitor openai_compat.seed_forwarded_total and openai_compat.reassembly.buffer_truncated_total during ramp.
qa_notes: Integration test harness includes token-level assertions for streaming assembly and a simulated non-deterministic adapter. Manual QA verified a customer reproduction (SUP-312) and confirmed metadata now appears in tool-run logs.
notes_for_support: If customers report missing seed in response.metadata after enabling the flag, check adapter capabilities in /internal/adapters/capabilities and search telemetry for reason=fallback. If reassembly errors surface, review openai_compat.streaming.reassembly.{request_id} traces to determine chunk ordering anomalies.
additional_context: This PR is intentionally conservative: behavior defaults to non-destructive proxying and additive metadata so we avoid surprising existing customers. Follow-up work planned (ENG-10042) will add end-to-end pinned determinism tests and SDK ergonomics for seed hints.
